competing_explanation: Global correlation near-ties can arise from duplicate or near-duplicate OTS members of the same source family. Local geometry can verify the family relationship without identifying one privileged filename; multiple accepted members must therefore all be excluded. Failure means only that this frozen geometric method did not resolve a target.
controls: positive pairs Haze4K train 101 to OTS 0870, Haze4K train 133 to OTS 7267, and Haze4K test 417 to OTS 6360
negative cross-pairs train 101 to OTS 7267, train 133 to OTS 6360, and test 417 to OTS 0870
parent terminal, summary, mapping, and 959-ID provisional exclusion asset are exact SHA-256-bound inputs
Haze4K test 69 to OTS 0354 and train 977 to OTS 1964 retain their parent global-match diagnostics but must independently pass geometry
a geometry FAIL is a method limitation, not proof that an underlying source relationship is absent

question: Do frozen local-feature and RANSAC geometry checks resolve Haze4K test 69, Haze4K train 977, and Haze4K train 937 to OTS source identities, while positive and negative controls separate and the deduplicated exclusion union preserves at least 6,000 OTS scenes?
